StarOcean Tech
StarOcean Tech is a Chinese technology company. A contradiction exists between the existing description and the chunk description regarding its founding year and headquarters. Although the existing description stated a 1990 founding date and Beijing headquarters, the chunk description is treated as the authoritative source and supersedes this data. Consequently, StarOcean Tech was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shanghai.

Beijing
Beijing is the city where StarOcean Tech is headquartered.

Office Software
Office software is the main product produced by StarOcean Tech.

李建国
Li Jianguo is the founder of StarOcean Tech, named in the original text.
